description:
After fz-sc8.124 (a self call keeps its caller's key at a slot the recursion supplies), nine activation keys per OptionParser program still differ only by empty_list() versus list(t) at an accumulator: three each on Enum.reduce/3#lambda@0/2, Enum.reverse/1#lambda@0/2 and List.reduce_cont/3. The cost is linear per program, not a product.

Investigated 2026-11-12 (spike, base c768670cd; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/y5x/: d2.diff, prog/, keys.sh):
- On self recursion the rebuilt-tuple and closure-result shapes are already cured by the self-call rule; they cost keys only across a cycle.
- The whole defect is call_key_types (jobs/semantic.rs) returning the arguments untouched when caller.function != function, so a cycle hop keys the supplied slot from the handed-over type.
- A positional rule (keep the caller activation's own column, traced through carried / built-from argument positions, with a subtype guard) collapses only the shape where the same value travels whole through a closure (toy programs a_cycle_closure 25 -> 23 keys, h_two_seeds 33 -> 29). It does nothing for a direct-cons cycle (the middle function does not name the slot in its key) or for the library's real shape, where the closure returns {:cont, acc}: Enum.reverse and the parse call are unchanged (214 keys, 2584 jobs). Without the guard it merges two seeds' ascents (a separation loss) and mis-keys reduce_step.
- Covering the real shape needs the key of a cycle member to carry which activation entered the cycle (an entering-activation token), which would also subsume the self-call special case. That is a new concept for about nine keys per program.

Not worth building for its own saving. Revisit if an entering-activation token is wanted for another reason, or if a program shows the cycle residue multiplying.
title: The cont<->step reduce recursion mints ascent rungs that no distinct return needs
